UPSSSC PET Exam Date 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the exam date for the UPSSSC Preliminary Examination Test (PET). Applications for the UPSSSC Preliminary Examination Test (PET) 2026 were accepted from 03 August 2026 to 07 September 2026. The examination is going to conducted on 23,24 & 25 October 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their UPSSSC PET Exam Date 2026 from the link.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 3 August 2026
  • Last Date : 07 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 07 September 2026
  • Form Correction Date : 08 September 2026
  • Exam Date : 23, 24 & 25 October 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, OBC : Rs. 185/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 95/-
  • PH : Rs. 25/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
